P. 10</ls>. .³({%d%}) Angry contradiction (अपाकरण); आः क एष मयि स्थिते <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; आः वृथामङ्गल पाठक <ls>Ve. 1</ls>. .³({%e%}) Sorrow, regret; विद्यामातरमाः प्रदर्श्य नृपशून् भिक्षामहे निस्त्रपाः <ls>Udb.</ls>; (आः स्मरणेऽपाकरणे कोपसंतापयोस्तथा <ls>Med.</ls>).

आस् I. €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> (आस्ते, आसांचके, आसिष्ट; आसितुम्, आसित) .²1 To sit, lie, rest; <ls>Bg. 2. 45</ls>; एतदासनमास्यताम् <ls>V. 5</ls>; आस्यतामिति चोक्तः सन्नासीताभिमुखं गुरोः <ls>Ms. 2. 193</ls>. .²2 To live, dwell; तावद्वर्षाण्यासते देवलोके <ls>Mb.</ls>; यत्रास्मै रोचते तत्रायमास्ताम् <ls>K. 196</ls>; कुरूनास्ते <ls>Sk.</ls>; यत्रामृतास आसते <ls>Rv. 9. 15. 2</ls>; <ls>Bk. 4. 6</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">8. 79</ls>. .²3 To sit quietly, take no hostile measures, remain idle; आसीनं त्वामुत्थापयति द्वयम् <ls>Śi. 2. 57</ls>. .²4 To be, exist. .²5 To be contained in; जगन्ति यस्यां सविकाशमासत <ls>Śi. 1. 23</ls>. .²6 To abide, remain, continue or be in any state, be doing anything, last; <ab>oft.</ab> used with present participles to denote a continuous or uninterrupted action; विदारयन्प्रगर्जंश्चास्ते <ls>Pt. 1</ls> kept on, continued, tearing up and bellowing; used in this sense also with an <ab>adj.</ab>, <ab>subst.</ab>, indeclinable, past <ab>part.</ab>, an adverb (तूष्णीम् <ab>&c.</ab>), or with the <ab>instr.</ab> of a noun; सुखेनास्ते <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 To lead to, result in (with <ab>dat.</ab>); आस्तां मानसतुष्टये सुकृतिनां नीतिर्नवोढेव वः <ls>H. 1. 185</ls>. .²8 To cease, have an end. .²9 To solemnize, celebrate. .²10 To let go, lay or put aside; आस्तां तावत् let it aside, let it go, to say nothing of, not to mention; <ls>K. 18</ls>. .²11 To be indifferent; ननु आस्ते इत्युपवेशने भवति . नावश्यमुपवेशने एव, औदासीन्येऽपि दृश्यते . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 6. 24</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to sit, seat, fix; आसयत्सलिले पृथ्वीम् <ls>Sk.</ls> {%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} आसिसिषते To wish to sit <ab>&c.</ab> --II. €4 <ab>P.</ab> [आस्यति, आसितुम्] .²1 To enclose; border. .²2 To admit (as water) into.
